patch.name: One invoice per payroll & staffing supplier per month
patch.condition: Each payroll, recruiter and employer-of-record payee should be paid once per calendar month
patch.rationale: Nothing in the policy limited how often a supplier can bill, so a second in-range Fathom invoice looked routine. History shows Fathom, Remote People and Deel billing once per calendar month. Backtest flags 6 past payments: September salaries for Isla Fraser, Priya Chandra and Rhys Owen were each paid twice (18th and 25th), £11,800 overpaid. Those are real findings, not false alarms.
